author: Will
description: Manage Server Tag and boost reward tiers in one server, with role-permission snapshots and owner approval for elevated roles.
short: Tiered tag and booster roles with permission audit
end_user_data_statement: Stores the bound server ID and per-guild reward role IDs, an optional basic eligibility role ID, enabled state, and an administrator-requested snapshot of role permission bits and channel-level role overwrites. No member-specific data is persisted. Explicit owner approvals of elevated reward role IDs and their permission bitsets are also stored.
